description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Turns what the brand sells (pasted text, or answers to the offer interview) into draft offers in its offer bank, with prices from the plan catalog, Shopify or the text. Charges Embers once per call (refunded when nothing usable comes back). Needs the Pro plan or higher.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/hook-studio/offers.)

brandId.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key may omit it.

text.description: What the brand sells, in any words.

name: offers_capture
